{{Otheruses|Chandrila}}
'''Chandrilan hors d'oeuvres''' were a food that shared their name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. When [[Zeta Magnus]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Halagad Ventor]] fought, the former ate the latter's fingers as if they were Chandrilan hors d'oeuvres.<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>
